scenarios.scenario: Recover from a recent-document search with no matches

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
no recent document matches "zzq_no_match_7319"
the user enters "zzq_no_match_7319" in Search recent
the user activates the Search control
the recent-document rows are replaced by a No results message
the page offers Clear search and filters
the user activates Clear search and filters
the search field is empty
the broader recent-document list is displayed again

scenarios.scenario: Clear an incompatible search and type filter

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the recent list includes a part named "Part26" and other document types
no assembly matches "Part26"

the matching part is displayed
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
the filter control indicates one active filter
No results is displayed

the user opens Filter
Assembly is unchecked

scenarios.scenario: Clear an active type filter while retaining the search

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
searching for "Part26" displays a matching recent part
no assembly matches "Part26"
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
No results is displayed
the filter control indicates one active filter
the user activates the clear control beside the active filter indicator
the Assembly filter is unchecked
the active-filter count is removed
the search field still contains "Part26"
the matching part is displayed again
the Filter panel remains open

scenarios.scenario: Preserve recent-document selections between list and grid views

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
two recent parts are displayed in List View
the first part's row is checked
the user switches to Grid View
the first part's card is checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected are displayed
the user checks the second part's card
the user switches back to List View
both parts' rows are checked and highlighted
Open Selected and Remove Selected remain displayed

scenarios.scenario: Filter out a selected recent part

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent parts and assemblies are displayed in List View
one part row is checked and no other rows are checked
no recent-document filters are active
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
assembly rows are displayed and the selected part is not displayed
Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed
the user clears the active filter
the part row is displayed again without a checkmark
Open Selected and Remove Selected remain absent
